stories.title: [UPDATE] [hoch] Vercel Next.js: Mehrere Schwachstellen
stories.summary: Ein Angreifer kann mehrere Schwachstellen in Vercel Next.js ausnutzen, um beliebigen Programmcode auszuführen, und um einen Denial of Service Angriff durchzuführen.
stories.explanation: Vercel Next.js (a web framework) has multiple security flaws that attackers can exploit to run their own code on servers or crash services. This matters because Next.js is widely used to build websites, so a flaw could affect many companies at once. Defenders typically apply security patches from Vercel as soon as they're released and monitor their systems for signs of attack.

stories.title: ConnectWise Suspends Cloud Backup After Attackers Compromise Microsoft 365 Tenants
stories.summary: ConnectWise on Saturday said it has disabled seven ConnectWise application identities as it continues its investigation into an incident in which unknown threat actors obtained unauthorized access to the application identities and compromised Microsoft 365 tenants. The disabled identities are listed below - ConnectWise Cloud Backup - 506e08f9-6e9a-4da4-942b-a099a03644ae ConnectWise
stories.explanation: ConnectWise (a management software company) discovered that attackers stole login credentials for seven of its applications and used them to break into customers' Microsoft 365 accounts. This matters because compromised Microsoft 365 accounts give attackers access to email, files, and other sensitive business data. Defenders should immediately reset passwords, check for unauthorized access, and change their ConnectWise credentials.

stories.title: Microsoft: October Windows Server updates break Exchange sign-in, mail flow
stories.summary: Microsoft has confirmed that this month's Windows Server security updates are causing OWA sign-in and mail delivery issues on some Exchange Server systems.
stories.explanation: Microsoft's October security updates for Windows Server are causing problems with Exchange Server (email software), preventing users from signing in and receiving mail. This matters because it creates a conflict between staying secure (applying patches) and keeping email working. Defenders should delay applying these updates until Microsoft releases a fix, while monitoring their systems closely for actual security threats.

stories.title: OpenCode Console Breach May Have Exposed OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google API Keys
stories.summary: An intruder reached a legacy system at OpenCode on the night of October 16 and may have exposed the third-party AI provider keys that users had saved in OpenCode Console, the company said. Console is OpenCode's optional hosted service: a workspace saves its own OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google key there, and Console uses that key to call the provider so team members can use the models without
stories.explanation: An attacker broke into an old system at OpenCode (a development tool company) and may have stolen API keys (access credentials) that users stored there for OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google services. This matters because stolen API keys let attackers use those expensive AI services on someone else's bill and access sensitive data. Defenders should assume their keys were compromised, rotate (replace) them immediately, and monitor for unusual charges.

stories.title: [UPDATE] [mittel] Fortinet FortiOS, FortiProxy und FortiSwitch: Schwachstelle ermöglicht Manipulation von Dateien
stories.summary: Ein lokaler Angreifer kann eine Schwachstelle in Fortinet FortiOS, Fortinet FortiProxy und Fortinet FortiSwitch ausnutzen, um Dateien zu manipulieren.
stories.explanation: Fortinet's firewall and network products have a flaw that lets an attacker with local access (already on the system) modify or delete files. This matters because file manipulation could disable security features or alter system configurations. Defenders should apply Fortinet's patches and limit which people have direct access to these devices.

stories.title: [UPDATE] [mittel] OpenVPN: Mehrere Schwachstellen ermöglichen Umgehen von Sicherheitsvorkehrungen
stories.summary: Ein lokaler Angreifer kann mehrere Schwachstellen in OpenVPN ausnutzen, um Sicherheitsvorkehrungen zu umgehen.
stories.explanation: OpenVPN (a remote access tool) has multiple flaws that let someone already on the system bypass security protections that are supposed to restrict what they can do. This matters because even a low-privilege attacker could escalate to gain full control. Defenders should update OpenVPN immediately and limit user accounts to only the access they truly need.

stories.title: [UPDATE] [mittel] OpenVPN: Schwachstelle ermöglicht DoS und die Offenlegung von Informationen
stories.summary: Ein entfernter, authentisierter Angreifer kann eine Schwachstelle in OpenVPN ausnutzen, um einen Denial of Service Angriff durchzuführen oder vertrauliche Informationen offenzulegen.
stories.explanation: OpenVPN has a flaw that lets someone who is already logged in crash the service (denial of service) or steal sensitive information from it. This matters because it could disrupt remote workers and leak credentials or data. Defenders should patch OpenVPN, monitor for unusual activity from authenticated users, and have backup remote access methods.

stories.title: Hackers exploit SiteGuard WAF flaw to run commands as admins
stories.summary: Attackers are targeting an OS command injection vulnerability in SiteGuard Server Edition that lets them execute commands as root or SYSTEM on affected servers.
stories.explanation: SiteGuard WAF (a web firewall) has a flaw that lets attackers inject operating system commands and run them with top-level (admin/root) privileges on the server. This matters because admin-level access means attackers can do almost anything, including stealing data or installing malware. Defenders should patch immediately and restrict network access to SiteGuard to only trusted locations.

cves.name: ISC BIND Data Processing Errors Vulnerability
cves.action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
cves.explanation: ISC BIND (DNS software that translates domain names to IP addresses) has a flaw in how it processes data that attackers can exploit. This matters because DNS is critical infrastructure—if it breaks, users can't reach websites. Defenders should update BIND, monitor DNS query logs for suspicious patterns, and have a DNS provider as backup.

cves.name: ProFTPD Improper Access Control Vulnerability
cves.action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
cves.explanation: ProFTPD (file transfer software) has a flaw that lets attackers bypass access controls and reach files they shouldn't be able to access. This matters because companies often use FTP to share files with partners or customers, and this flaw could expose those files. Defenders should update ProFTPD, disable it if unused, and restrict FTP access by IP address.

cves.name: Apache Struts Command Injection Vulnerability
cves.action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
cves.explanation: Apache Struts (a web application framework) has a flaw that lets attackers inject and run arbitrary commands on the server. This matters because many web applications use Struts, so this could affect multiple systems. Defenders should update Struts immediately, use a web application firewall to block suspicious input, and scan code for this vulnerability.

cves.name: Ivanti Connect Secure Authentication Bypass by Spoofing Vulnerability
cves.action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
cves.explanation: Ivanti Connect Secure (a remote access VPN product) has a flaw that lets attackers bypass authentication (login requirements) by spoofing (faking) legitimate connections. This matters because VPNs are supposed to be the last line of defense—if you can skip login, attackers get direct access to internal networks. Defenders should patch immediately, reset user sessions, and check logs for unauthorized logins.

cves.name: ONLYOFFICE Docs Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
cves.action: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
cves.explanation: ONLYOFFICE Docs Server (document editing software) has a path traversal flaw that lets attackers access files they shouldn't by manipulating file paths in requests. This matters because users typically store sensitive documents in these systems. Defenders should patch immediately, restrict ONLYOFFICE to trusted networks, and monitor for suspicious file access.
